ability_rule.Steal_legality: Resolved provisionally by LAWSET_PREACADEMY_CIVIL_V1 for the starting district; this is ORIGINAL_FILLER and may be superseded by verified source law.
ability_rule.harm_and_theft_events: Physical/social consequences are still simulated even when the exact legal label is unknown.

principles: No in-world offense exists unless a law entry is active for that jurisdiction and world time.
World truth, witness belief, evidence, suspicion, charge and adjudication are separate states.
Law enforcement has finite jurisdiction, staffing, information and response time.
An arrest or detention is not equivalent to guilt.
NPCs cannot enforce a rule they do not know or have no authority to enforce.
Penalties may not be invented as canon when the applicable law is unknown.
